ios.desc:
Strongbox Zero is a version of the well known and loved Strongbox with all of the networking code and as many third party libraries stripped out as we could! Think of it as the Drag Racer version of Strongbox! 

If you're a fan of Local Only password managers this could be the right choice for you. 

We recommend you get to know (and love!) the regular Strongbox first through the Freemium app. Once you're happy and sure you want to go local only, go for Strongbox Zero...

Strongbox Zero is an application for keeping all your passwords safely stored and protected by one master password. Supporting the open source Password Safe and KeePass formats. 

*** Features ***
- Face ID/Touch ID Unlock for the ultimate in convenience, security and speed.

- PIN Code Unlock with a Duress PIN option for those tricky situations.

- YubiKey protection - secure your databases with a hardware token.

- Secure - protected by time tested military grade cryptography.

- Private - Isolated In-App attachments viewer for your sensitive documents, photos & videos.

- Audit your passwords - Automatically check your database for weak passwords

- Search your entire set of passwords and secrets instantly and powerfully, with deep search. Autocomplete new entries, and auto generate secure passwords. 

- Compatible - Import/Export by Files app, Email, CSV, iTunes File Sharing

- Standards compliant - using the time tested Password Safe and KeePass formats so you can import any existing password safe you have.

- Features galore 
   - Incredibly configurable password generation including Diceware (XKCD) & regular passwords.
   - Timed Auto Clear Clipboard.
   - Entry History.
   - KeePass Field References, Tags & Custom Icons.
   - Two Factor Authentication codes (TOTP) - QR Code, Steam & Manual.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
